offlineBody: Connect to the internet to view current data. Portfolio data is not stored offline.
update: A new app version is available
testBody: Notifications work on this device. Open the app settings.
fallbackBody: New notification. See the app for details.
enabled: Notifications are enabled on this device.
disabled: Notifications are disabled on this device.
sent: Test requested. Quiet hours may delay delivery.
denied: Notifications are blocked. Change permission in your browser settings.
installFirst: On iPhone or iPad, first add the app to your Home Screen from the Share menu, then open it using the icon.
error: Unable to change notifications. Try again.
consent: When enabled, notifications may appear on your lock screen. They contain alert facts without portfolio amounts.
